dataset: Li, Daie, Svoboda & Druckmann 2016; CRCNS alm-3 / DANDI 000011 release 0.220126.1907
lock_status: FROZEN BEFORE INSPECTION OF NWB TRIAL OR SPIKE VALUES
purpose: External replication of the Chen raw same-session test using an independent ALM recording-plus-photoinhibition dataset.
population: standard tactile delayed-response sessions containing extracellular ALM spiking, control trials, and unilateral ALM photoinhibition trials; callosotomy-only sessions are excluded if explicitly identified by metadata

primary_predictor.name: control-trial local choice selectivity
primary_predictor.definition: For each eligible unit, compute AUC separating right-choice versus left-choice control-trial spike counts in an 800-ms early-delay window from -1.7 to -0.9 s relative to the response/go cue. Transform to 2*abs(AUC-0.5), then average eligible units within the recorded hemisphere/session.
primary_predictor.trial_restriction: control trials only; correct and error trials included; early-lick/invalid trials excluded where metadata permits
primary_predictor.unit_restriction: manually curated putative pyramidal units when source metadata expose cell type and quality; otherwise all sorted units with at least 10 control trials per choice are retained and the fallback is reported without changing the metric

primary_outcome.name: same-session unilateral photoinhibition behavioral impairment
primary_outcome.definition: For unilateral ALM photoinhibition of the recorded hemisphere, compute control accuracy minus photoinhibition accuracy separately for right- and left-choice trials and average the two choice-specific differences when both are estimable.
primary_outcome.minimum_trials: at least 10 control and 5 photoinhibition trials for each included choice side

aggregation: Average eligible sessions within each mouse before primary inference. If multiple recorded hemispheres are present for a mouse, treat mouse-by-hemisphere values as repeated measures and use mouse-blocked permutation; also report side-specific mouse means.
primary_statistic: Spearman rank association between frozen control-trial selectivity and same-hemisphere behavioral impairment, with one-sided positive mouse-blocked permutation P value.
generalization_test: leave-one-mouse-out linear prediction; report held-out Spearman rho and out-of-sample R2 relative to a training-mean baseline
success_criterion: positive primary Spearman association with one-sided P<0.05 AND positive leave-one-mouse-out R2
secondary_diagnostics: session-level association reported descriptively because sessions repeat mice
side-specific associations when hemisphere metadata permit
sensitivity to equal-session versus equal-mouse aggregation
implementation_rule: Field-name/schema adaptations needed to read NWB are allowed after this lock, but predictor/outcome definitions, windows, directionality, inferential unit and success criterion may not be changed after trial or spike values are inspected.
publication_awareness: The qualitative published conclusion that ALM dynamics recover after unilateral perturbation is known. Exact NWB-derived predictor/outcome values and their association are not inspected before this lock.
